tools.name: fahce_diagnose_integrity
tools.description: Find unsupported claims and contradictions in an answer; the REST operation returns diagnosis and a receipt. Example: compare 'Deployment succeeded' with a failure log. MCP advertises this operation; execute through POST /api/v1/diagnose using x402. No external actions are performed.

tools.name: fahce_plan_bounded_repair
tools.description: Plan evidence-preserving corrections; the REST operation returns a bounded plan and receipt. Example: request a correction for a success claim contradicted by a failure log. MCP advertises this operation; execute through POST /api/v1/repair using x402. Proposed steps are not executed.

tools.name: fahce_verify_repaired_output
tools.description: Check a revised answer against supplied records; the REST operation returns a scoped verification determination and receipt. Example: recheck 'Deployment failed' against its failure log. MCP advertises this operation; execute through POST /api/v1/verify using x402. Caller records are not authenticat

tools.name: fahce_integrity_repair_bundle
tools.description: Combine diagnosis, a bounded correction plan when needed, and submitted-answer verification in one REST receipt. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fahce_verify_repaired_output · Private data: fahce_verify_repaired_output · Public sink: fahce_diagnose_integrity, fahce_plan_bounded_repair, fahce_verify_repaired_output, fahce_integrity_repair_bundle · Destructive: fahce_diagnose_integrity, fahce_plan_bounded_repair, fahce_verify_repaired_output, fahce_integrity_repair_bundle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fahce_verify_repaired_output · Private data: fahce_verify_repaired_output · Public sink: fahce_diagnose_integrity, fahce_plan_bounded_repair, fahce_verify_repaired_output, fahce_integrity_repair_bundle · Destructive: fahce_diagnose_integrity, fahce_plan_bounded_repair, fahce_verify_repaired_output, fahce_integrity_repair_bundle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
